click: a single small plastic remote control button click, close
fridge_open: a small fridge door opening with a soft suction pop
mags_servo: a small ceiling-mounted robot camera turning on its mount: one short soft electric servo motor whir, close, quiet shop, no music
tin_step: one single step of a heavy tin wind-up toy robot on a hard stone floor: a hollow metallic clack with a tiny clockwork click, close, dry, no music
clank: a small tin toy robot stopping: a light metallic clank
powerdown: an electronic machine powering down: a falling whine and an old screen switching off, cartoon
thud: a heavy metal fire extinguisher slammed down on a lab bench, a solid clank
chalk: chalk drawing a big circle on a chalkboard, one continuous scrape
cloth: four separate quick rustles of a stiff cotton lab coat sleeve as arms are thrown up, close, dry, pauses between, no voice
steps_lab: slow footsteps of one person in soft leather shoes on a bare concrete basement floor, eight separate steps with short gaps, dry, no music, no voices
beep: a microwave oven button beep, one short electronic beep
toaster_pop: a pop-up toaster springing up hard: a metallic spring twang and two slices of toast flying out, close, indoor, no music
ice_dispense: a refrigerator door ice dispenser: a short motor grind, then ice cubes clattering out onto a hard countertop and skittering, close, indoor, no music
desk_bell: a hotel reception desk bell struck once: one bright metallic ding ringing out, close, quiet room, no music
lamp: a small table lamp switched on indoors, single soft click
